rationale: Both Mufaddal and Uriah work in embedded systems with overlapping tech stacks (C, Python, and hands-on hardware), but bring complementary strengths—Mufaddal's production automotive-grade expertise in embedded Linux, Bluetooth, and OTA updates pairs well with Uriah's broader physics simulation and hardware hacking background. This is a mutual match, and they could explore collaboration on embedded projects that bridge automotive or IoT connectivity with computational modeling.
intro_message: Mufaddal, meet Uriah B—an Oakland-based engineering consultant exploring embedded systems and hardware hacking who shares your C and low-level systems focus and could bring fresh perspectives from simulation and physics modeling.
